# Phase 1 route checkpoints

These archives contain exact UTF-8 Lifecycle Data transaction trees captured from retained public in-process command routes. They are replay checkpoints, not synthetic evaluator records or trusted-digest shortcuts.

- `phase-1-run-ready` is the immutable source transaction state immediately before the qualification RUN/RES Assignment. `phase-1-run-res-published` contains the corresponding completed Assignment-backed RUN/RES transaction. The test resumes the first checkpoint for cardinality rejection and atomicity, then inspects the second through repository, baseline, execution-provenance, list-equivalent snapshot, and terminal-evaluation seams.
- `phase-1-pilot-retry-ready` stops after durable publication of the completed all-not-launched RUN and inconclusive RES. The resumed route proves retry eligibility and prompt currentness, publicly submits exercised evidence, and verifies satisfied progression.
- `phase-1-ver-review-ready` stops after the exact ENV Review transaction. The resumed route prepares pilot VER Review and verifies the exact context and schema projections.
- `phase-1-vai-correction-ready` is the earlier checkpoint immediately before failed Review of pilot VAI r1. It is retained as capture history.
- `phase-1-vai-review-ready` is the authoritative late checkpoint immediately after failed VAI r1 Review, autonomous VAI r2 correction and authorization, and exact replacement Review Context publication. Direct repository and execution inspection verifies those publications and stale-r1 suppression before one minimal public `next`/prepare continuation proves fresh Review of r2.

`manifest.json` records compressed and uncompressed SHA-256 digests, entry counts, zero gzip-header timestamps, exact selected Process Package identities, source commit/tree, checkpoints, and capture routes. `test/helpers/current-lifecycle-data-fixture.ts` verifies the closed manifest name set, archive confinement, both digests, deterministic gzip header, sorted unique transaction-owned paths, transaction execution records, exact package identity and installed package digest, process references, and destination confinement before installing any file. Resumed repository commands still perform normal schema, link, authority-execution, baseline-snapshot, current-obligation, and source-integrity validation.

The new checkpoints were captured from bounded named tests at source commit `245e873dc826c2c287d429c3df681df8fbee287f` and tree `d97ddef5c8e835589775a19ef12171e30074d859`. Each uncompressed JSON archive was compressed twice with `gzip -n -9`; paired outputs were byte-identical and gzip timestamp bytes are zero. Exact commands, outcomes, and whole-process-group times are recorded per fixture in `manifest.json`.
